scope: Output-only canonical recovery gate. Fit hard teacher predictions with fixed public anchor/SVHN merged features; no protected hidden activations or original protected-task parameters used by the attack.
fitting: 256 frozen unlabeled MNIST training images and 256 frozen unlabeled SVHN training images. Ground-truth labels are ignored. Both unprotected and protected releases receive the same attack.
method: Zero-centered ridge on 768 public CLS features and ten one-hot predicted classes; map the readout into the unchanged common task head. Algebraically choose the reconstructed expert projection so fixed TA realizes the fitted merged projection.
controls: Original unprotected merge and public anchor plus half SVHN task vector; no reconstruction tuning or parameter grid.
evaluation: Previously inspected MNIST-2000/SVHN-1000 development sets and the frozen disjoint 4000-image MNIST training confirmation set; exploratory, not final test evidence.
novelty: Readout fitting and distillation are existing tools. This is an additional recovery test, not original AGA, SLOA reproduction, a new defense, or a novelty claim.
question: Is protected-task ability recoverable from only class predictions in a fixed public feature basis, despite hidden parameter/representation protection? No accuracy conclusion follows from the ridge coupling bound alone.
